term: that than which nothing greater can be thought
definition: Anselm's description of God (Proslogion 2): a being than which no greater can be conceived. It is a modal and conceptual notion, not a maximum among the beings found in things.
note: Recorded for contrast only, so that maxime ens is not read as the ontological argument's description. No root-path statement uses it, and no Proslogion witness is pinned.
